description: List the signed-in person's collections, sound boards, or both, with each one's id, name, kind, revision and item count. Use it when a collection id is needed for get_collection, add_to_collection or another collection tool. Not for finding a saved track by name; use search_collections for that. Returns { collections, archived_count, entitlements }. Read-only; needs a signed-in account. The Free plan holds 1 collection and 1 sound board; Pro holds up to 1,000 of each; a lapsed Pro account can view everything but edit only one collection and one sound board. Example: {"kind":"all"}.

include_archived.description: true also lists archived collections, which are hidden by default but still count toward the plan cap.

kind.description: Which kind to list: "collection" (the default), "board" for sound boards, or "all" for both, such as "all".

name: list_collections

archived_count.description: Archived collections that still count toward the plan cap, even when they are hidden from the list.

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: List collections
